text.id: Dermaga kayu. Bakau di kiri. Kapal biru-putih diiket di ujung. Gue udah pernah lihat tempat ini. Di layar HP Sekar, jam lima kurang dua.
text.en: A wooden jetty. Mangroves on the left. A blue and white boat tied at the end. I've seen this place before. On Sekar's screen, at two minutes to five.

text.id: Di ujung dermaga ada orang duduk. Rambutnya setengah diiket. Jaket hijau tentara yang kegedean. Alat rekam diangkat ke arah laut.
text.en: Someone is sitting at the end of the jetty. Hair tied half up. An oversized army-green jacket. A recorder held up toward the sea.

text.id: Tasya lari duluan. Nggak peduli papannya licin. Mereka pelukan kayak dua orang yang jatuh barengan.
text.en: Tasya runs first. She doesn't care that the planks are slippery. They hug like two people falling together.

text.id: Kar. Gue yang bilang ke bos. Gue kira gue ngelindungin kamu. Gue salah.
text.en: Kar. I'm the one who told my boss. I thought I was protecting you. I was wrong.

text.id: Gue tahu, Bim. Gue tahu dari Senin malem. Nanti. Bukan sekarang.
text.en: I know, Bim. I've known since Monday night. Later. Not now.
And you. You're a year late.

text.id: Kapalnya Pak Karta berangkat tepat waktu. Gue yang nggak.
text.en: Pak Karta's boat left on time. I didn't.

text.id: Semua orang di dermaga diem. Sekar nungguin jawaban. Lagi.
text.en: Everyone on the jetty goes quiet. Sekar is waiting for an answer. Again.
"I'm sorry, Kar. For all of it."

text.id: "Episode-episode lo bagus. Semuanya. Harusnya gue bilang dari dulu."
text.en: "Your episodes were good. All of them. I should have said so back then."

text.id: "Lo bilang gue bakal tahu harus mulai dari mana. Gue mulai."
text.en: "You said I'd know where to start. I started."

text.id: Setahun gue nungguin satu kata itu. Di depan Tasya, lagi.{w} ...Makasih, Ka.
text.en: A year I waited for that one word. In front of Tasya, too.{w} ...Thank you, Ka.

text.id: Tas, lo denger? Dia bilang bagus. Rekam. Rekam sekarang.
text.en: Tas, did you hear that? He said they were good. Record it. Record it now.
I have been the whole time.

text.id: Lo denger voice note-nya.{w} Gue rekam itu jam dua pagi, sambil mikir lo nggak bakal pernah denger.
text.en: You heard the voice note.{w} I recorded that at two in the morning, thinking you'd never hear it.

text.id: Kapal polisi. Sama speedboat putih. Dua puluh menit lagi.
text.en: The police boat. And a white speedboat. Twenty minutes.
